title: 第826章 可不可以快一点我快要绷不住了第825章 你应激就来一发天帝拳
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
“天儿是谁？”
“咳咳，仙儿，不用计较这些有的没的。”
叶天澜飞快传音，假装没看见仙儿取笑的模样。
他右拳之上鎏金拳罡凝聚，一拳轰向面前那头母蛭抽来的触手。
拳罡与触手碰撞，炸开一圈环形气浪，他整个人被震退了十几步，双脚在地面上犁出两道长长的沟痕。
“孽畜！”
魏观暴喝一声，战刃出鞘，墨黑色的刀罡撕裂夜色，气贯长虹，一刀劈飞了另一根抽来的触手，将其根部彻底粉碎！
饶是如此，他的虎口同样被震得发麻，刀刃上传来的反震力道让他暗暗心惊。
这两头母蛭虽然不比之前那只吃饱喝足的强，但也绝对差不到哪里去，在他的感知中恐怕也是只差一步便可迈入紫府境！
真要放开了打他未必怕。
但眼下还在演，他只能竭力把刀罡控制在法相后期的水准。
不过越阶而已，该不会真有人觉得他经常吃瘪就是真的菜了吧？
明明是跟着叶天澜那个混蛋打多了远超当前境界的高端局而已。
不是老辈子就是老辈子！
试问哪个正常的法相境遇见了紫府不跑路的，他那般当场逃跑改日再变强回来方是天才正道。
这家伙纯粹压力怪一个，当不得真。
只要不来老辈子，他魏观就是无敌的！
想到此，他气势磅礴，奋力拼杀！
大黄狗在一阵嗷嗷怪叫声中悄然退至魏观身后。
然后一把被魏观拎住尾巴当成法器砸向从右边杀来的狰狞触手。

“嗷嗷嗷！魏观，你没有心！”
“叫尼玛，借你的身体一用。”
“嗷嗷！要死了！要死了！！”
“狗日的，死了我赔你！”
“再叫我用你寄吧。”
“你不是吹你全身上下最硬的就那玩意儿吗。”
大黄狗回光返照般抖了一下机灵，扭头看着他，期待道：
“抓？”
“打！”
“嗷嗷嗷！！”
在场之人无不嘴角抽搐了一下。
就连原本气势汹汹的两头噬魂母蛭也同样觉得很变态，扭动的肥胖身躯停顿了一下。
香玲儿和敕凤等人稳住心神之后也纷纷出手，五颜六色的灵光在夜空中交织成一片，看着声势不小，但打在两头母蛭身上只能留下浅浅的痕迹。
姜玄带着青鸾宗六人退到了演武场边缘的安全地带。
他双手负后，目光从战场上缓缓扫过，把每个人的表现都看在眼里。
那个使刀的黑衣青年刀势霸烈，但母蛭的触手每抽一下他就只能后退，明显气力不足，撑不了多久。
至于叶天澜拳罡看着挺唬人的，打在母蛭身上也就是让那团肉晃一晃，连皮都没破。
至于剩下那几人，基本上是在刮痧。
他身后那个年轻弟子已经懒得掩饰了，嘴角挂着一抹毫不掩饰的讥讽。
“师兄，就这水平还学人出来除魔卫道呢，两只母蛭就把他们打成这样，再拖一会儿怕不是要全军覆没。”

姜玄没有回答，目光落在战场中央那道还在跟母蛭缠斗的白袍身影上。
就在这时候，叶天澜被一根触手抽飞，整个人在空中倒退出数百丈才堪堪稳住身形。
他捂着胸口，脸色发白，转头朝姜玄的方向喊道。
“姜兄！这两头畜生我们顶不住！请姜兄出手相助！”
一本正经。
content_en:
"Who is Tian'er?"
"Ahem, Xian'er, don't worry about whether these things are available or not."
Ye Tianlan quickly transmitted the message and pretended not to see Xian'er's teasing look.
The gold-plated fist was concentrated on his right fist, and he punched the tentacle drawn by the female leech in front of him.
The fist collided with the tentacles and exploded in a circular air wave. He was knocked back more than ten steps, and his feet plowed two long grooves on the ground.
"Evil beast!"
Wei Guan shouted violently, unsheathed his war blade, and the dark black blade tore through the night. His energy flowed through the rainbow, and he slashed away another tentacle drawn out with one blade, completely shattering its root!
Even so, his tiger's mouth was also numb from the shock, and the force of the shock coming from the blade made him secretly frightened.
Although these two female leeches are no better than the well-fed and drunk one before, they are definitely not far behind. In his perception, they are probably only one step away from entering the Purple Mansion Realm!
If you really want to let go and hit him, you may not be afraid.
But he was still acting at the moment, so he could only try his best to control Daogang to the level of the late Dharma phase.
It's just that he's overstepped his rank. Could it be that some people really think that he's a real dish if he's often deflated?
He obviously just followed that bastard Ye Tianlan and played many high-end games that were far beyond his current level.
Either the old generation or the old generation!
Let me ask you, who in the normal Dharma Realm would not run away when he met Zi Mansion? It would be a genius for him to run away on the spot and come back stronger another day.
This guy is just a blame person due to pressure, so he can’t take it seriously.
As long as he doesn't come back to his old life, Wei Guan will be invincible!
Thinking of this, he became powerful and fought hard!
The big yellow dog quietly retreated behind Wei Guan amidst a burst of snarling sounds.
Then Wei Guan grabbed his tail and used it as a magic weapon to smash at the ferocious tentacles coming from the right.
"Ouch! Wei Guan, you have no heart!"
"Call me, I'll lend you your body."
"Ouch! I'm going to die! I'm going to die!!"
"You bitch, I'll pay you if you die!"
"Ask me to send it to you again."
"Aren't you going to blow on the hardest thing on your body?"
The big yellow dog twitched its wits like a flashback, turned to look at him, and said expectantly:
"Catch?"
"Hit!"
"Ouch!"
Everyone present had their mouths twitching.
Even the originally menacing two-headed soul-eating mother leech felt very perverted, and her writhing fat body paused for a moment.
After Xiang Ling'er, Chi Feng and others stabilized their minds, they also took action one after another. The colorful spiritual lights intertwined in the night sky. They seemed to be quite powerful, but they could only leave shallow traces on the two female leeches.
Jiang Xuan led the six members of the Qingluan Sect to retreat to a safe area at the edge of the martial arts field.
He put his hands behind his back and slowly swept his gaze across the battlefield, taking in everyone's performance.
The young man in black used the sword with great force, but every time the mother leech's tentacles twitched him, he could only retreat. It was obvious that he was not strong enough and could not hold on for long.
As for Ye Tianlan's fist, it looked quite intimidating. If it hit the female leech, it would make the mass of flesh shake, without even breaking the skin.
As for the remaining few people, they are basically scraping.
The young disciple behind him was too lazy to hide it, and there was an undisguised sarcasm on his lips.
"Senior brother, at this level, there are still students who come out to slay demons and defend the way. Two female leeches beat them like this. If we delay for a while, the whole army will be annihilated."
Jiang Xuan did not answer, his eyes fell on the white-robed figure in the center of the battlefield who was still fighting with the mother leech.
At this moment, Ye Tianlan was whipped away by a tentacle, and he fell back hundreds of feet in the air before he could stabilize his body.
He clutched his chest, turned pale, turned his head and shouted in Jiang Xuan's direction.
"Brother Jiang! We can't stand these two beasts! Please help Brother Jiang!"
Serious.
